name: hash-xx64
algorithm: std XXH64, seed 0 over splitmix64 bytes, reps passes with a one-byte write-back (mk/hash-xx64.mk).

skip.c: no std hash: C has no standard XXH64, seed 0
skip.rust: no std XXH64, seed 0: Rust std has none (only SipHash-1-3 in DefaultHasher); no crate stands in
skip.go: no std XXH64, seed 0: Go std has none (hash/maphash is a different, seeded hash); no module stands in

notes: Idiomatic standard library: one call of each language's std function per pass (plan/06-m6.md 4.1). Bytes per second = mib * 1048576 * reps / median.

Checksums: Mk (mk build -release), Zig 0.17.0 (-O ReleaseFast -mcpu=x86_64_v2) and, where it has the function, Go 1.27.3 (GOAMD64=v2) printed the same values for args and quick on the owner's machine, 2026-11-06 (std-hashmod session 1). The publish-size checksum was re-agreed by every column in `go run ./tools/bench verify -publish-size` on the owner's machine, 2026-11-07 (std-hashmod session 5, after the reps were raised).
